forensic_summary: TRIGGER: Catastrophic structural disintegration during Impact Testing where 7 of 7 Sativa units suffered 'Front housing and back cover separate', compounded by a 6/7 failure rate for 'Front housing corner coating peel off' during micro-drops. INTERVENTION: The Architect mandated a structural overhaul to a 'Full Circle Hinge' design, adding reinforcement ribs and removing chamfers to lock the housing. Concurrently enforced a 'VDI-15' finish change on the substrate to resolve paint adhesion delamination. RESULT: Modified mockups passed Drop, Crush, and Rapid Pull tests, securing the premium 'Room Director' configuration for DVT.

war_stories.label: Structural Disintegration
war_stories.description: Redesigned hinge geometry to 'Full Circle' profile to arrest 100% impact failure rate (7/7).

war_stories.label: Paint Delamination
war_stories.description: Mandated substrate change from Gloss to VDI-15 to resolve 85% paint peel failure (SAT-127).

war_stories.label: Display Integrity
war_stories.description: Enforced 5-hour liquid glue cure process to bridge 0.3mm gap and prevent Touch Panel lift-off.

war_stories.label: Dead Front Aesthetic
war_stories.description: Engineered IR film stack and curved-glass pad printing to conceal sensors and seal light leakage.

war_stories.label: OLED Integration
war_stories.description: Managed AUO/Biel partnership to align OLED Active Area with Glass Viewing Area, overcoming code incompatibility.
